## Product identity

IZEM AI Fitness Coach is an independently developed, early-stage consumer fitness application built for iOS and Android. The app/package identifier is `com.ai.gym.coach`. IZEM is not affiliated with the B2B consulting website at `youraicoach.ai` or with unrelated businesses that use the name IZEM.

Public storefront availability can vary during release and rollout. Do not infer a live App Store or Google Play listing from this file alone; use the actual storefront as the authority for current availability, price, renewal terms, eligibility, and purchase status.

## What IZEM currently does

### Coach, chat, and live voice

- IZEM includes AI text chat and live two-way coach calls.
- Premium members can start a live coach call from the app.
- Eligible non-subscribers can receive one complimentary onboarding coach call. That connected test-call entitlement is available once and the session is capped at 5 minutes; an unanswered ring may be retried.
- Optional coach-initiated calls can support planned-workout accountability and review moments when the account, platform, allowance, and call preferences permit.
- Supported coaching context can include the user's current profile and goals, equipment and schedule, today's workout and meal plan, logged meals, recent performance, useful saved memories, previous supported call summaries, recent changes, body-scan context, and separately consented Apple Health context when available.
- IZEM has a user-controlled coaching-intensity setting that changes the coach's tone, directness, pacing, and emotional intensity. Do not invent named coach personalities that are not shown in the current product.

### Workout planning and execution

- IZEM creates personalized weekly workout plans using goals, experience level, available equipment, schedule, session duration, and supplied constraints.
- Workout execution supports set-by-set repetitions and load tracking, rest guidance, workout history, difficulty/effort feedback, and full or partial workout logging.
- Supported exercise replacements and workout-day adjustments can be made when a plan needs to change.
- Progression guidance can use logged performance and feedback.
- IZEM does not claim to measure bar velocity and does not replace hands-on exercise-form supervision from a qualified professional.

### Nutrition

- IZEM creates personalized meal plans using dietary preferences, allergies, meal count, and calorie/macro targets.
- Meals can be logged, and supported meals can be replaced or adjusted.
- The active meal plan generates a grocery list inside the nutrition workflow.
- Food-photo analysis can estimate calories and macros. These are estimates, not laboratory measurements.
- Users with allergies or medical dietary requirements should verify ingredients themselves and use qualified professional guidance when appropriate.

### Scans and progress

- Optional food-photo scans provide estimated calorie and macro context.
- Optional gym-equipment scans can identify equipment and provide general setup context and exercise ideas.
- Optional body-progress scans can provide approximate visual baselines and trend context. They are not clinical body-composition measurements.
- IZEM supports weight logging and weight-history/trend views.
- The progress experience includes a current training streak and recorded workout evidence rather than invented progress.

### Apple Health

On supported iPhones, after the user separately grants permission, IZEM can read a bounded Apple Health overview containing available data from these categories:

- steps and exercise minutes;
- sleep;
- workouts, including duration and available energy data;
- resting heart rate;
- heart-rate variability (HRV);
- body mass.

Apple Health access is read-only. Missing or denied Health data is not treated as a zero. A minimized summary can support relevant coaching only after separate consent. Apple Health information is context for general fitness coaching, not diagnosis, treatment, emergency monitoring, or medical advice.

## Pricing and access

The public website currently references a $24.99/month premium membership. The storefront shown to the user is authoritative for the exact current price, currency, renewal period, eligibility, call allowances, trial or introductory-offer availability, and any annual option.

Do not claim a universal 7-day trial. Do not claim unlimited calling unless the current storefront and account entitlement explicitly say so.

## Safety and limitations

IZEM provides general fitness and nutrition guidance for adults. It does not diagnose injuries or medical conditions, provide medical treatment, replace injury rehabilitation, provide hands-on exercise-form correction, or guarantee results. Scan outputs are coaching context, not clinical measurements. Users should seek qualified professional guidance for pain, injury, medical conditions, eating disorders, pregnancy-related needs, allergies requiring medical management, or technical lifting instruction.

## Evidence and social-proof policy

IZEM should not publish fabricated reviews, fabricated download counts, invented user outcomes, fake before-and-after transformations, fictional testing, or guaranteed results. If public store ratings, reviews, downloads, release history, or independent validation are not currently verifiable, say that plainly rather than manufacturing proof.
